messages.subject: Using rms function with Sample or Wave objects
messages.subject_clean: Using rms function with Sample or Wave objects
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,
I would like to measure RMS from field recordings, but I found that
rms () function doesn't work with Sample or Wave objects. R returns
the follow error:

> s <- loadSample ("/Users/macpro_fz/Desktop/sound.wav")
> class (s)
[1] "Sample"
> rms(s)
[1] NA
Mensajes de aviso perdidos
In mean.default(x^2, ...) :
  argument is not numeric or logical: returning NA
> s
type      : mono
rate      : 44100 samples / second
quality   : 16 bits / sample
length    : 3021350 samples
R memory  : 12085400 bytes
HD memory : 6042744 bytes
duration  : 68.511 seconds

## or

> data (tico)
> class (tico)
[1] "Wave"
attr(,"package")
[1] "tuneR"
> rms (tico)
[1] NA
Mensajes de aviso perdidos
In mean.default(x^2, ...) :
  argument is not numeric or logical: returning NA

I tried to use as.matrix () or as.vector () to coerce the Sample or
Wave object to a "numeric" mode, but it didn't work. Do you know how I
could fix this trouble?
Thank you

messages.body_plain:
Hi diego,

You need to extract the values of the Sample or Wave object.

s<- loadSample ("/Users/macpro_fz/Desktop/sound.wav")

val<- s$sound[1, ]

or

s<- readWave ("/Users/macpro_fz/Desktop/sound.wav")
val<- s@left

Best

Jerome
